title: Geometric-fibre properties below Weil compact-support realization
statement: For a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], geometric base change of a finite-type k₀-scheme has its canonical structure map to Spec(k), is locally finite type and quasi-compact. The geometric map [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category] respects these structure maps and preserves separatedness, local finite type, quasi-compactness, properness and open immersions. For any prime l≠D.p the image of l is a unit in D.k. These are canonical property proofs, with no new geometric or coefficient data.

proof.text: Use the pullback second projection for the geometric structure map. Apply Mathlib base-change stability via MorphismProperty.overPullbackMap to every listed morphism property. The Over morphism equation proves compatibility with the structure maps. The structure-map finite-type and quasi-compactness instances are reused from the existing SfCommonStageWeilCohomology base-change API rather than duplicated.
The cardinality formula gives characteristic D.p in D.k₀ and its injective inclusion gives that characteristic in D.k. Since l is a different prime, its image is nonzero in D.k, hence a unit.
